digest.component_or_area: Jira bridge multi-project rehearsal and integration testing
propositions: Non-existent project keys cause JQL parse errors that abort entire passes because the inbound fetcher lacks per-project try/except handling, whereas the fake transport masked this by returning empty results.
Live-Cloud rehearsal against two shared production projects cannot model three repo shapes, an empty project, and unknown-project fail-closed behavior simultaneously without cross-contamination risk.
The rehearsal must run against the ephemeral Jira DC instance in CI where throwaway projects can be created and destroyed per run with admin rights, providing isolation and reproducibility.
Every mutating scenario must be preview-gated to verify that planned mutations target only the intended project with zero intersection against other configured projects before sync is applied.
All scratch projects must be deleted on every exit path including mid-run failures, using session-scoped finalizers that poll until 404 to ensure cleanup durability.
Configured-but-absent projects must fail closed with a RebarError containing 'outside the configured scope' rather than silently succeeding or propagating raw JQL errors.
